title: Transport strikes a go as fare hikes take effect

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Commuters face higher fares beginning on Monday and at least three days of strike led by two major transport groups, as the government lifts the suspension of fare increases approved in March. Public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers and operators have expressed dissatisfaction over the fare increases as they called for bigger adjustments
